diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Asghar Hajeb, a board member of the Bushehr Teachers' Union, has been summoned again to the Revolutionary Court. He was arrested in May by security forces and released on bail. He is accused of propaganda against the regime and must appear in court on September 1.

Images sent to Iran International show the critical and poor condition of prisoners in Isfahan Central Prison. At least 400 detainees of the Iranian National Revolution are held there without access to lawyers or family visits. This information was reported by the audience and Iran International.

Mark Fife, former US national security advisor, told Al Jazeera that China has reduced its daily oil imports from Iran from 1.5 million barrels to 500,000 barrels and has turned to buying from Brazil, Iraq, and Russia to meet its oil needs.

The Washington Post reported that senior US military officials warned Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth that continued large-scale operations against the Islamic Republic are unsustainable and weaken the US military's ability to counter other threats. The warnings were given in a secret document dated August 14, and senior commanders registered non-concurrence with the order to extend deployment but will execute it.

The Washington Post reported that senior US military officials warned Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth that continued large-scale military operations against Iran are unsustainable and weaken the military's ability to counter other threats. The warnings were recorded in a secret document, and commanders expressed non-concurrence with extending troop deployments. CENTCOM has kept over 50,000 troops on alert, and some deployments have been extended until 2027.

Pouria Shahrabadi, Danial Eiri, and Pouria Latififar have been added to the Iran U23 football team camp. The U23 team is preparing for the Asian competitions and will play its first match on September 16 in Nagoya against the UAE. They are in a group with the UAE, North Korea, and China.

Zahra Mousavi, arrested during the December 2025 protests, is imprisoned in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad. She has been sentenced to a total of 10 years and six months in prison, with four years to be served and six years and six months suspended. This sentence was issued by the Revolutionary Court.

The head of the Civil Registration Organization announced that the smart national ID cards of 6 million Iranian citizens have not yet been issued and delivered. He attributed this to inflation of laws and multiple responsible agencies. He also mentioned that significant improvements will be made regarding the photos on the ID cards.

Iranians residing in Berlin held a protest gathering and raised the Lion and Sun flag. They carried images of those who died in the protests and emphasized keeping their memory alive. The protesters demanded the expulsion of Islamic Republic diplomats from Germany.
Nemat Elhami, a candidate for the twelfth parliamentary elections from Parsabad, Bileh Savar, and Aslanduz, suddenly suffered cardiac arrest and died during a nighttime rally speech.

Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that he will refill the US strategic national reserve with Venezuelan oil, calling the reserves empty due to Joe Biden's performance. He said the process of completing these reserves will begin soon and considered it a gift from Venezuela to the American people.

Donald Trump announced that Venezuelan oil will be used to fill the United States' strategic reserves. He described this action as a gift from the people of Venezuela to the people of the United States. The process of filling the reserves will begin soon.

Mehrdad Goodarzvand Chegini, deputy head of the Parliament's Budget and Planning Commission, emphasized expanding barter trade with neighboring countries and using national currencies in trade to gradually phase out the dollar. He cited Qatar as a successful example and stated the goal is to increase the presence of Iranian goods and services in regional and global markets. Defense, oil and gas, and medical and engineering services are among Iran's export capacities.

The Tabriz Civil Registration Office has refused to issue a birth certificate for a boy named 'Berkay' more than seven months after his birth. The parents' complaints against the registration office were rejected by the peace courts in Tabriz. The family presented another birth certificate with the same name to the court, but the registration office stated it belonged to a different person.

Behzad Akbari stated that more than 30 percent of the world's most visited domains are blocked for Iranian users. The Infrastructure Communications Company monitors access to about 700,000 domains around the clock. This statistic does not include internal filtering in Iran, which worsens the situation.

The Yemeni naval forces seized a boat carrying drone parts from the Islamic Republic that was heading to the Houthis. The Yemeni National Resistance has released images of these parts. This incident took place on the western coast of Yemen.

A citizen reported that the Iranian estradiol pill, prescribed to compensate for estrogen deficiency, has become scarce. He had to obtain the foreign version at a high cost. This issue was reported in a video to Iran International.

Greece and Israel will sign a $3.5 billion agreement on Monday to establish the "Achilles Shield" air and missile defense network. The plan is designed to counter hostile drones, missiles, and aircraft.

Mojtaba Khamenei called for Gulf countries to unite with Iran against the US and Israel. Israel's energy minister warned that if Iran resumes its missile and nuclear programs, Israel will attack Iran. This report was provided by Mojtaba Pourmohsen.

Omid Pourfathollah, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was sentenced by the Mashhad Revolutionary Court to 12 years, six months, and one day in prison. Five years of this sentence have been suspended. His charges include forming a group aimed at disrupting security and propaganda against the regime.

Saeed Jalili stated that the idea of resolving issues through negotiation must be corrected and deterrence occurs when the opponent knows their actions will not go unanswered. He emphasized the need to maximize the use of the Strait of Hormuz's capacity. Jalili also mentioned that war is not limited to the military domain but includes economic, political, media, and security areas.

The Lebanese Foreign Ministry stated that the Islamic Republic must pursue its relations with Lebanon through official and legal institutions and should not independently engage with internal parties. The ministry welcomed Tehran's desire to maintain good relations with the Lebanese government. Lebanon also emphasized that relations must be conducted through governments and respect for sovereignty must be observed.

Mehdi Moslehi said the US is implementing a long-term strategy by limiting Iran's oil exports and protecting the passage of Arab oil tankers. He added that Iran has lost a large part of its oil market and leverage over the Strait of Hormuz. The relative calm in the oil market indicates traders do not expect a complete halt in regional oil exports.

The deputy of primary education in North Khorasan's education department announced the identification of 1304 children out of school in the province. So far, 442 of these children have been enrolled in schools. The status of the remaining 862 children is still being followed up.

Shayan Samiei explained the US effort to involve G20 countries in economic pressure on the Islamic Republic. He said the key point is the decision of banks, shipping companies, and global insurers to continue or stop cooperation with Tehran. Cooperation with the Islamic Republic could jeopardize their access to the US financial system.

The media office of Prince Reza Pahlavi described the death sentences for 10 protesters in Isfahan as cruel and unjust. These sentences were issued with human rights violations and torture to obtain forced confessions. The government aims to create fear and suppress public anger.

A citizen sent a video showing white balloons released with the names of deceased doctors. This act commemorates doctors killed in the national revolution. It also honors doctors who have been detained for helping people.

Morad Vaisi reported intensified disputes at the senior levels of the IRGC concerning power factions and the preservation of the Islamic Republic. He identified two main factions: the "reconciliation-oriented" led by Qalibaf and the "confrontational" centered on Mohsen Rezaei, Ahmad Vahidi, and Hossein Taeb. According to him, with Qalibaf's weakening position, the confrontational faction has gained more power.

Miad Maleki stated that the goal of removing the educational exemption is not Iranian students but to prevent misuse by the IRGC and affiliated institutions. The decision does not mean a permanent halt to educational services, and companies can continue with a license from the US Treasury. This mechanism is designed to maintain educational services while preventing misuse.

Ted Cruz, Republican senator, in an interview with NBC News, emphasized that the US does not have a duty to determine who rules Iran. He said that America's duty is to say that Iran's government should not be an extremist religious government that hates America and tries to kill Americans.

After the war ended, the Iranian government intensified its social control policies in the digital space. These policies include blocking Instagram pages, content removal, and pressure on online businesses. These actions coincide with the start of the third leadership period and efforts to establish a new order.

A wastewater project was inaugurated in Maragheh. During the ceremony, Ali Khamenei and Mojtaba Khamenei were mentioned. These projects, funded with over 130 billion tomans, will cover tens of thousands of people.

The Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the US fulfills its commitments. The US claims the strait is open for itself but closed for Iran. This issue was discussed in an interview with Masoud Kazemi.
A report has been published about a secret route of the United States in the heart of the Strait of Hormuz. This route has high strategic importance. More details are provided in the report.

Amirhossein Safari, a protester arrested during the December 2025 protests, was executed along with Abolfazl Sepahi in Isfahan. Safari's body was buried in the deserts near Khor and Biabanak. A citizen sent a video of his grave to Iran International.
The number of executions at Adelabad Prison in Shiraz has increased to two. Another prisoner was executed on Monday, 24 August. This information was reported by Harana News Agency.

Yesterday in Tehran, three workers including a child laborer were involved in an accident due to lack of workplace safety. Two were injured and one lost their life. The unsafe working conditions were cited as the cause of the incident.

The Intelligence Organization of the IRGC stated that the enemy is using psychological warfare to weaken stability in Iran. The organization considers confronting the enemy's command capabilities and the network of terrorist collaborators as a response to these actions. Individuals described as disruptors of stability and unity are also targeted for confrontation.

The national under-23 team's camp was canceled due to the absence of invited players at the Olympic Hotel, announced by Hossein Abdi. Abdi stated that if the number of players does not reach 10 or no goalkeeper arrives, the team is not formed. Only a few of the 23 invited players attended the camp.

Amirreza Pedram, a detainee from the 1404 protests, is serving his sentence in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad. He was sentenced to six years and three months in prison. After a hunger strike protesting quarantine conditions, he was transferred to ward 104 of the fourth disciplinary section.

Chris Bettsov, a former US Treasury official, says the IRGC has moved many of its activities to hidden networks. He discusses the preservation of Iran's drone and missile programs and the role of international financial supply chains. He also mentions actions the US can take to disrupt these networks.

Pedram Zangoui explained the continuation of the naval blockade and the costs of protecting shipping routes. He said the US is trying to control energy prices and buy time by maintaining naval pressure. He also noted that the consequences of the recession at Bandar-e Rajaee and disruptions in the entry of goods will directly affect society.

An American official told Al Jazeera that US forces targeted two missile launch platforms belonging to the IRGC on Larak Island on Sunday. The official said the two Islamic Republic missile launch platforms were preparing to fire naval mine-carrying missiles toward the Strait of Hormuz.

Manshe Amir, a Middle East expert, said that the weakening of Hezbollah and the reduction of financial support from the Islamic Republic have changed Lebanon's political equations. He believes the Lebanese government now has the ability to counter Hezbollah's military influence. It has also taken the path of dialogue with Israel.

American forces targeted two Iranian launchers on Larak Island. These launchers belonged to the Revolutionary Guards and were preparing to fire rocket-propelled naval mines into the Strait of Hormuz. This action took place earlier today.
Fars News Agency reported hearing an explosion sound on Larak Island. The exact location and cause of the explosion are not yet known.

Tasnim news agency reported a drone attack on Larak Island in Hormozgan province. Initial unofficial reports indicate that 2 people have been killed and 2 injured in the attack. The attack has been attributed to the United States.

Ali Alipour scored in the Persepolis vs Malavan match, reaching Ali Parvin's record of 95 goals for the team. He has scored 95 goals wearing the Persepolis jersey so far. Farshad Pious holds the top record with 153 goals.

The Revolutionary Guards confirmed the US military attack on Larak Island. The attack resulted in the death and injury of several soldiers. The Guards stated that this action will be responded to and the enemy will be punished.

A passenger ship with about 270 people capsized near Kyrenia port in Northern Cyprus. At least seven people have died and 237 have been rescued. Twenty-three people are missing and rescue operations are ongoing.

Mohammad Taghavi stated in the Hattrick program that Hossein Kanaani-Zadegan is currently the best central defender in Iran in playmaking. He also noted that Persepolis attacks Malavan's goal with many players. This analysis was made during the technical review of the Persepolis vs Malavan match.

Tabnak reported that missiles were fired from central Iran towards unknown targets. This report came after the US attacked two IRGC launch platforms on Larak Island. The IRGC confirmed the US attack and promised to punish American forces.

Ebrahim Azizi, head of the Parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, threatened Washington with a reciprocal response to the US attack on Lark Island. He wrote on the social network X that US actions 'will not go unanswered,' but did not elaborate on the type or timing of the possible reaction. The remarks came after US forces targeted two IRGC launchers on Lark Island.

The U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that its forces, as part of enforcing the blockade against Iran, had rerouted 83 commercial ships, disabled three, and boarded two by August 30 to ensure compliance with the blockade.
A missile was launched from Khorramabad.

Yemeni armed forces identified and destroyed a Houthi bomb-laden unmanned boat in the Red Sea. The exact location of the destruction was not disclosed. This incident occurred amid rising maritime tensions in the region.

John Bolton, former US National Security Advisor, described China as a test of Washington's will to confront Iran's economy. He said China is a major buyer of Iranian oil and plays a key role in Tehran's financial activities. These remarks coincided with the Trump administration's efforts to increase economic pressure on Iran.

Reuters reported, citing two US officials, that US forces targeted two launch platforms belonging to the Islamic Republic on Lark Island. According to these officials, IRGC forces were observed preparing to launch missiles carrying naval mines toward the Strait of Hormuz.

Kamyar Behrang from Iran International said recent developments have led some US and Israeli policymakers to conclude that the strategy to change the behavior of the Islamic Republic has failed. They are now looking to end the threat posed by the Islamic Republic. Behrang emphasized that the new strategy should focus on the role of the Iranian people and opposition forces.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said the Islamic Republic has abandoned its main governmental duties and has become a factory producing daily problems for the people. He added that this situation is a major reason for people's hatred and their desire for the swift overthrow of the regime.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, expressed concern about the reopening of schools on the first of Mehr. Families are uncertain whether their children will attend school in person or virtually, and their safety amid militaristic actions is not guaranteed. Additionally, virtual education faces internet issues, depriving children of a safe and calm educational environment.

Istanbul will host the first strategic political and defense committee meeting of the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement between Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia. This meeting is a step toward implementing the pact, which considers an attack on any member as an attack on all. The report is by Narges Hoorakhsh from Iran International.

Scott Bassett, the US Treasury Secretary, announced that the Trump administration plans to sanction another bank this week due to its connections with Iranian transactions. The aim is to increase pressure on the economic partners of the Islamic Republic. The details of the targeted bank have not yet been disclosed.

Morad Veysi, senior analyst at Iran International, said that instead of solving people's problems, the Islamic Republic creates new issues through interference in lifestyle and warmongering. He added that internet shutdowns have destroyed virtual businesses and children's education and endanger lives during wartime.

An American source told Fox News that almost all missiles fired by the Islamic Republic in the recent wave of attacks were intercepted. The source did not provide further details about the number of missiles, the location of the interception, or possible damage.

A Fox News journalist, citing an American source, reported that Iran targeted American forces stationed in Jordan. No details were provided about the location of the attack, the type of weapons used, or possible casualties. American officials have not yet officially confirmed the attack.

Videos published on social media show the interception of missiles fired by the IRGC in the sky of Jordan. An American source told Fox News that almost all the missiles that the Islamic Republic had fired in the recent stage of attacks were intercepted.

Reuters reported that oil prices rose by more than two percent, with Brent crude surpassing $90 per barrel. This increase followed a US attack on two IRGC launchers on Larak Island. This attack is the first known US strike on targets in Iran since late July.

The IRGC responded to US drone attacks on Larak Island by targeting two airbases in Jordan with ballistic missiles. Jordan's air defenses intercepted most missiles, and no significant damage was reported. These attacks caused oil prices to rise over two percent, with Brent crude surpassing $90 per barrel.

Reuters reported that the number of commercial ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz has decreased to five per day. Shipping companies are passing with more caution due to repeated attacks. Some ships have turned off their automatic identification systems to reduce the risk of attack.

The Jordanian army announced that it intercepted eight missiles after they entered the country's airspace on Monday morning. This news was released after the IRGC announced that in response to the US attack on Lark Island, it targeted the King Hussein and Al-Azraq airbases in Jordan with ballistic missiles and drones. An American source had also previously stated that almost all missiles fired by Iran were intercepted at this stage.

CENTCOM announced that US forces took "limited and precise" action to counter what it called an "imminent threat" from IRGC mine-laying forces in the Strait of Hormuz. CENTCOM called the IRGC's statement, which described the US attack as an "aggressive act," "completely false," stating that Iran created the threat. This position relates to the August 30th attack by US forces on two IRGC launchers on Lark Island, which US officials said were being prepared for mine-laying.

Israel Hayom reported that war, sanctions, and mismanagement have worsened the livelihood crisis in Iran. The media also cited corruption and the presence of the IRGC in the economy as factors in economic problems. Experts warned that economic pressure may lead to increased repression or military actions.

US President Donald Trump said on Sunday, 8 Shahrivar, that the Islamic Republic will not obtain a nuclear weapon and that he does not necessarily need a signed agreement to win the fight against Iran. He stated that the US naval blockade and financial pressure have dealt heavy blows to Iran, causing the regime to collapse. Trump called Iran the biggest state sponsor of terrorism and stressed that they cannot be allowed to have nuclear weapons.

CENTCOM denied the IRGC's claim about US attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. According to CENTCOM, the US took limited and precise action against IRGC mine-laying forces posing a threat. The US stated its goal was to protect civilian mariners and global trade flow.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, said that the Treasury will likely announce new secondary sanctions every week to increase economic pressure on Iran, with banks being the first target. He also mentioned the action against the Egyptian bank branch in the UAE due to ties with Tehran and warned that the next step could be cutting off a financial institution's access to the dollar system. Bessent added that at the G20 meeting he will ask finance ministers to sever economic ties with Iran or face US secondary sanctions.
According to received messages, there was an earthquake in east Tehran. No further details have been provided. This news was reported by Vahid Online.
An earthquake of magnitude 3.8 occurred in Pardis, east of Tehran.

The IRGC Navy announced that a supertanker attempting to pass through the illegal route south of the Strait of Hormuz caught fire and came to a complete stop after hitting two naval mines. The force warned that the fate of ships violating the security regulations of the Strait of Hormuz will be nothing but this. It also asked shipping companies not to be deceived by the US Army's provocations.

Donald Trump shared an AI-generated video of an attack and explosion on Iran's Kharg Island. Trump wrote that Kharg Island is being destroyed. The video was released hours after CENTCOM attacked missile launchers on Larak Island.

The IRGC Navy announced that a supertanker in the southern Strait of Hormuz caught fire and stopped after hitting two naval mines. The IRGC warned that ships not following Iran's regulations will be targeted. This statement was released after CENTCOM's attacks on missile launchers on Larak Island.

Iran's army public relations announced that after US attacks on Larak Island, the Al-Minhad base in the UAE was targeted with dozens of drones. This base hosts American helicopters and forces. Iran's army emphasized it stands firm to ensure national security until the enemy threat is removed.

Mehdi Ketabchi described the water crisis in Iran as beyond a temporary drought, calling it a continuous water bankruptcy. He stated that the Islamic Republic is willing to consume natural and human resources to sustain itself. Without structural changes in policy and resource management, water resource recovery is not possible.

Amir Hamidi commented on the US attack on two IRGC launchers in Larak Island. He said that increased missile and drone attacks or pressure on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz could lead to an expanded US response. This response might target more parts of the IRGC's military and naval network.

Erfan Ghanei-Fard said Israel has placed the defeat of the Islamic Republic at the top of its regional goals. Israel considers the Islamic Republic as the center of a network that includes Hamas and Hezbollah. Due to the security and military vulnerabilities of the Islamic Republic, Israel aims to weaken this center.

Amir Giti from Iran International reported on US attacks to prevent the IRGC from laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Washington has shortened the gap between warning and action. Alongside the blockade of ports and intensified sanctions, pressure on the Islamic Republic has increased.

A group of Iranians living in Calgary, Canada, held a weekly gathering demanding the overthrow of the Islamic Republic and the cessation of executions in Iran. Participants carried Lion and Sun flags and images of martyrs. They emphasized avoiding distractions and focusing on the demands of the people inside Iran.

A report in Australia warned that some universities in the country have collaborated with Iran in dual-use research fields. The report reviewed 21 studies with potential military applications. Earlier, the Australian Minister of Education vetoed 13 research grants due to national security concerns.

The UAE Ministry of Defense announced that its air forces confronted a drone that entered UAE territorial waters from Iran. The UAE armed forces are on full alert. Air defense systems continuously monitor the airspace around the clock.

Videos received by Iran International show a memorial birthday ceremony for Mohammad Hossein Jamshidi at his grave. Mohammad Hossein was killed on January 9, 2026, in Hesar Karaj by agents of the Islamic Republic.

The UAE Ministry of Defense denied reports of the Al Minhad airbase being targeted by missiles. The ministry stated that the armed forces remain on full alert. Earlier, the Iranian army announced it had targeted the base with dozens of drones.

Hedayat Mombini was removed from the secretary general position of the Football Federation, and Hamed Momeni was introduced as the acting secretary general. Mombini faced criticism for nominating Gol Gohar instead of Chadormalu as Iran's third representative in the AFC Champions League.

The overdue salary increases for social security retirees, which were supposed to be paid on September 9, were not paid. People complain about economic problems and severe inflation. Fuel shortages at some gas stations have also been reported.

Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah stated that bypassing sanctions is currently very difficult and there is an oil blockade through the Strait of Hormuz and the Sea of Oman. He mentioned that there are ways to sell oil under sanctions, but the actions are confidential. He also expressed concerns about investment in insecure conditions.

Anwar Gargash, the UAE foreign policy advisor, called the Islamic Republic's policy targeting Gulf countries and Jordan a failure. He emphasized the need for realistic and sustainable political solutions. He also called for moving beyond tensions and restoring shipping in the Strait of Hormuz to normal conditions.
A man accused of acid attack on his sister in Tehran was arrested. The incident occurred on Friday, 6 Shahrivar. The suspect stated family disputes as the reason for his action.

Novak Djokovic lost in the first round of the US Open for the first time in his twentieth appearance. He was defeated by Mariano Navone in a 4 hour and 36 minute match. This was his heaviest first-round Grand Slam defeat since 2006.
A citizen in Ahvaz says the electricity in their area is cut off three times a day. He attributes this situation to the actions of the Islamic Republic. The reason for these outages is unclear.

Mohammad Jafar Ghaem Panah, the executive deputy of Pezeshkian, spoke about the economic situation and inflation in Iran. He said inflation ranges from 30 to 80 percent and food inflation is 123 percent. He also mentioned budget problems and the impact of war on inflation.

The Iranian women's national football team camp will be held from September 2 to 8 at the National Football Center to produce a documentary about the players' return from Australia. The camp has faced protests from league coaches. Farideh Shojaei stated that the main goal is to film the documentary and players will not be pressured with football training.

Ruhollah Rahimpour said the likelihood of renewed clashes has increased after US attacks on IRGC positions on Larak Island, but a full-scale war is unlikely. He added that the US has shifted its tactics to preventive actions to avoid blocking the Strait of Hormuz.

Morteza Kazemian described the IRGC attacks on the UAE and Jordan as mostly propagandistic and performative. He stated that the US continues to deliver precise and controlled strikes against the Islamic Republic. If American forces are killed, the cycle may get out of control and lead to a new phase of war.

Reza Goharzad discussed the new secondary US sanctions and pressure on Egypt Bank branches in the UAE to isolate Iran economically. He said economic pressure alone will not lead to the overthrow of the Islamic Republic. The overthrow will ultimately be by the Iranian people through protests.

Fatemeh Mohitizadeh broke the national heptathlon record with 5813 points at the women's national athletics championship in Shiraz. She has improved the record three times in less than a year. This achievement makes her one of Iran's main hopes in athletics for the Nagoya Asian Games.

Manshe Amir, a Middle East expert, said that although it is not possible to discuss Israel's practical plans regarding Netanyahu's emphasis on overthrowing the Islamic Republic, Israel has shown initiative in the past. He added that Israel has plans and capabilities to facilitate a popular uprising in Iran and can implement them if necessary.

A citizen sent a video showing darkness in Mahestan city in Alborz province. He says there is no electricity in the morning and power outages occur at night. This highlights electricity problems in the area.

Mehdi Torabi, the national winger of Tractor, has suffered a severe injury to his cruciate ligament during team training. Initial examinations have increased concerns about a ligament tear, and doctors will perform additional MRIs for final confirmation. If confirmed, Torabi will face a long absence from the field and will miss the 2027 Asian Cup.

The death sentence of Ali Asghar Peygambari, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was confirmed by the Supreme Court. He was recently transferred from Tehran Grand Prison to Qezel Hesar Prison in Karaj. This transfer has caused concern for his family.

Hossein Aghaei stated that a new round of US attacks in Larak occurred in response to the Islamic Republic's efforts to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. The continuation of these attacks depends on Tehran's subsequent actions.

Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei stated that the enemy and their agents are planning anti-security actions in Iran. He warned that a strong response will be given if unrest occurs. Security forces and the judiciary are at the highest level of readiness.

Messages and videos report long queues and closure of some fuel stations in various cities in Iran. Access to gasoline has become difficult, and queues continue even at midnight. This issue is discussed in an interview with Leila Saadati.

The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs reserves the right to respond to recent drone attacks by the Islamic Republic according to international law. These attacks are described as violations of sovereignty and threats to UAE security. The UAE holds the Islamic Republic fully responsible for these attacks and their consequences.

The 107th Tehran derby will be held on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, at the Naqsh-e Jahan Stadium in Isfahan. Despite the stadium's 75,000 capacity, only 35,000 tickets have been offered, with 29,000 for men and 6,000 for women. The ticket share for Esteghlal and Persepolis is equally divided.

Mani Safarpour, an 18-year-old from Lahijan, was killed by government agents with gunfire in Sarsabil, Tehran on January 8, 2026. A video shows his mother's distress while arranging his clothes. This incident was reported to Iran International.

The deputy of food and drug at Shiraz University of Medical Sciences reported a complete shortage of about 40 types of medicines needed by special and cancer patients. A significant part of this shortage involves imported and expensive drugs. Currency transfer issues, sanctions, and lengthy import processes are factors contributing to this situation.
A citizen sent a video showing a dark road at night. He says the road lights are off and the lane markings are inadequate. Drivers have to take risks while driving on this road.

The first strategic political and defense committee meeting of the Makkah Defense Pact will be held on Tuesday in Istanbul. Officials from Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia will participate in the meeting. It is expected that the framework for establishing a secretariat and mechanisms for future cooperation will be determined.

Asaad Salehi, a board member of the Supreme Association of Workers' Trade Unions, called for updating wages due to the sharp decline in workers' purchasing power. He rejected claims that wage increases cause inflation and described the allocation of ration cards as shirking legal responsibility. Salehi emphasized that workers' household expenses can only be met through a real increase in purchasing power.

Kayhan newspaper accused the government media section of leaking a video of an internal government meeting, calling it 'feeding the enemy.' Kayhan also accused appeasers of retreating from enrichment and missile programs. This reaction followed the release of Masoud Pezeshkian's criticism of the IRIB.

Masoud Pezeshkian stated in a meeting with the Indian Prime Minister that the Islamic Republic has adhered to its commitments under agreements, but the US has not fulfilled its obligations. He emphasized efforts to achieve a path of agreement and understanding and said the continuation of war benefits no one. He also highlighted India's significant capacity to help strengthen peace and stability in the region.

In an Instagram poll by Iran International, over 44% of respondents said that despite having financial means, they are unwilling to invest in or buy property in Iran due to the country's unstable conditions. The poll was conducted on Instagram. More details are available in an interview with Seba Heydarkhani.

The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it reserves the full and legitimate right to respond to recent drone attacks by the Islamic Republic in accordance with international law. This statement was issued on Monday, 9th of Shahrivar. An Iran International reporter covers reactions to the Islamic Republic's attacks in the region.

A citizen from Shiraz reported that fuel stations announce the end of their fuel card quota after a few hours. Then they sell gasoline at a higher price. This issue was sent to Iran International in a video.

On the evening of Sunday, 8 Shahrivar 1405, the US army targeted two IRGC launchers on Larak Island. The IRGC confirmed casualties among its forces and local residents. The governor of Qeshm stated that two people were killed and one wounded in the attack.

Hamidreza Hajibabaei, the deputy speaker of the parliament, stated that any country exporting oil to reduce international pressure on the US should be attacked. He also said that anyone aiding the US should be targeted and that the Islamic Republic should surround the US in the region. Hajibabaei emphasized that they have dealt and will deal multiple times the damage to the US in military attacks.

A citizen reported that the Agriculture Jihad of Mashhad has not provided tractor fuel quotas for six months and has only paid one-third of the wheat payments. Additionally, they do not supply diesel and water is cut off for six hours a day. The Agriculture Jihad office in Mashhad has closed its main doors, and employees enter through the back door and parking lot.

Saeed Golsorkhi, a 31-year-old athlete from Shahroud, was killed during a security forces raid on his home after being injured in the National Iranian Revolution in January. He died in his mother's arms and in front of his young nephew. More details are provided in an interview with Farnoush Faraji.
Ebrahim Rahmanpour, a citizen from Naqadeh, was sentenced by the judicial authority to 38 months and 15 days of imprisonment.

Reports indicate that in the suburban areas of Gorgan, water is available only 8 hours a day and was completely cut off on Sunday. People complain about fuel shortages and frequent power outages in villages. Additionally, hijab enforcers have returned and coercive measures have started gradually in cities.

The Minister of Education announced that more than 15,000 students with special needs have been left out of education. This statistic pertains to the country's special education sector. This issue raises concerns about access to education for these students.

The price of the US dollar in Iran surpassed 210,000 tomans on Monday, 9th of Shahrivar. The British pound also exceeded 284,000 tomans and the euro reached around 243,000 tomans. The price of each new design gold coin also exceeded 223 million tomans.

The Hana Human Rights Organization reported that at least 77 Kurdish citizens in cities and villages of Kurdistan have been arrested by security agencies. Most of these arrests were made without summons or judicial orders. Three detainees were sentenced to 74 lashes and one received a death sentence.

Thirteen citizens from Qorveh were sentenced to a total of 24 years, three months, and one day in prison by Branch 102 of the criminal court. Four of them were also sentenced to a total of 196 lashes, and one was sentenced to two years of exile in Minab. These sentences are related to the December protests.

Donald Trump announced that the United States will respond tonight to Iran's missile attack on American forces. He emphasized that a hard strike will be delivered to Iran. Trump said there will be a response.

Abolfazl Shekarchi, senior spokesperson of the armed forces, described the US army as a Hollywood and promotional army. He said their greatest pride is revealing the weakness and lack of morale of the US and Israeli armies. According to him, the whole world has understood this.

Four citizens from Zahedan arrested during the 1401 nationwide protests were sentenced to prison by the Zahedan Criminal Court. Hamidreza Kouhkan, Ahmadali Kouhkan, and Mohammad Khrot Dinmohammadi each received five years in prison, while Khaled Kashani was sentenced to two years and one day, with his sentence suspended. Khaled Kashani's sentence has been suspended.

Hakan Fidan, Turkey's foreign minister, described Netanyahu as a major threat to the region and the international community. He called the Israeli prime minister a criminal and said he must be stopped. These remarks were made at the Political and Defense Committee meeting of the Mecca Pact in Istanbul.

Masoud Pezeshkian and Abbas Araghchi participated in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Kyrgyzstan. Pezeshkian will meet with regional officials on the sidelines of the summit. Presidents of Turkey, Russia, and China, as well as prime ministers of India and Pakistan, are also attending the summit.

CENTCOM stated that no ship in the Strait of Hormuz has hit a mine. The command rejected the IRGC's claim about a supertanker hitting two naval mines and stopping. CENTCOM described this claim as an attempt to intimidate commercial shipping in the region.

The executive deputy of Masoud Pezeshkian stated that the government's financial and currency policies have caused inflation and increased living pressures. Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah said that due to budget deficits, they are forced to print money, which creates inflation. Economic journalist Ashkan Nezamabadi described this admission as unprecedented but containing misleading points.
